caption: A man in a green shirt sits at a table before a whiteboard, holding a clear plastic bottle upright in a metal pot that rests on a small electric hot plate. A pink balloon is stretched over the bottle's mouth, and his right hand steadies the bottle neck while his left hand pinches the loose top of the balloon. For the first part of the clip the balloon hangs limp and deflated to one side. As he talks, the balloon body gradually swells into a rounded, inflated shape protruding from the bottle opening. His left hand then releases the balloon and lifts into an open-palm gesture, moving outward beside him. The right hand continues to grip the bottle, keeping it standing in the pot. A white bowl sits untouched on the table to his right throughout the scene.
